levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: Saduq's tariq statement: three routes toward Ibn Adhafar; the text does not write the father's chain, and the shared names after «جميعا» are read on the third route only; the route split is not settled by the text.
«رضي اللّه عنهما» is dropped; «أبي» is the compiler's father, a bare relation word.
